questions.stem: Which document is issued by a seller to a buyer indicating the products, quantities, and agreed prices?
questions.explanation: An invoice is issued by a seller to a buyer and contains details of the products, quantities, and prices agreed upon.

distractorRationale.a: A receipt acknowledges payment, not the details of a sale.
distractorRationale.c: A credit note reduces the amount owed, not details of a new sale.
distractorRationale.d: A debit note is used for returns or requesting a reduction, not for new sales.

questions.stem: What is the primary purpose of a credit note?

options.text: To reduce the amount owed by a buyer
To request payment from a buyer

questions.explanation: A credit note is used to reduce the amount owed by a buyer, often due to returned goods or allowances.

distractorRationale.a: A receipt acknowledges payment, not a reduction in amount owed.
distractorRationale.b: An invoice indicates a sale, not a credit note.
distractorRationale.d: An invoice requests payment, not a credit note.

questions.stem: In which book of original entry would an invoice be recorded?
questions.explanation: An invoice is recorded in the Sales Journal as it represents a sale made by the business.

distractorRationale.a: The Cash Book records cash transactions, not credit sales.
distractorRationale.c: The Purchases Journal records purchases, not sales.
distractorRationale.d: The General Journal is for non-routine transactions, not regular sales.

questions.stem: A debit note is issued by a seller to reduce the amount owed by a buyer.
questions.explanation: A debit note is issued by a buyer to a seller, not the other way around, to request a reduction in the amount owed.

questions.stem: Which of the following statements correctly distinguishes between a credit note and a debit note?

options.text: A credit note is issued by a buyer, while a debit note is issued by a seller.
A credit note increases the amount owed, while a debit note decreases it.
A credit note decreases the amount owed, while a debit note is issued by a buyer.
A credit note is used for cash transactions, while a debit note is for credit transactions.

questions.explanation: A credit note decreases the amount owed by a buyer, while a debit note is issued by a buyer to request a reduction.

distractorRationale.a: Credit notes are issued by sellers, and debit notes by buyers.
distractorRationale.b: Credit notes decrease the amount owed, not increase it.
distractorRationale.d: Both credit and debit notes are related to credit transactions, not cash.
